text: もうスピードで　とびまわり　おしりの　どくばりで　さしまくる。

structure.jp: もうスピードで　とびまわり
structure.en: it flies around at tremendous speed and

structure.jp: おしりの　どくばりで
structure.en: with the poison stinger on its rear

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる added to a verb says the action is done over and over, wildly. さしまくる = 'stings again and again'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing tells you how or with what the action is done. もうスピードで = 'at tremendous speed'.

patterns.name: 〜連用形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short like this (とびまわり instead of とびまわります) means 'and' in written style, the same as とびまわって. とびまわり = 'flies around and'.
